value.answer: Tomorrow in Windsor looks mostly sunny and hot, around 29 to 30°C, feeling like about 35 in the afternoon. There's a chance of a shower early in the morning, around 30 to 40 percent, then it clears up. It gets breezy in the afternoon with gusts to about 50 km/h, and the UV is high, so bring sunscreen. Those are from this morning's forecasts, which mostly agree.
